name: Vile Corruption (Su)
body:
Prerequisite: Path of the Eternal Night

Benefit: The nightblade’s corruption makes creatures uneasy while they remain in its area. A creature that fails its saving throw against the nightblade’s corruption is sickened for 1d4 rounds. This duration does not stack.
